Row.Text: Eureka!
Inspiration
Writing
Envoys return with tales of foreign peoples. Meet 2 civilizations and request Open Borders with one of them.
Contact and a request for Open Borders hasten Writing — a share of its research is already complete.
Irrigation
Farmers put the whole land to use. Build 6 different types of rural improvement anywhere in your empire.
A countryside worked six ways hastens Irrigation — a share of its research is already complete.
Masonry
Quarry crews learn the grain of the stone. Build a Quarry.
Your Quarry hastens Masonry — a share of its research is already complete.
Currency
Coin binds one crown to another. Support 4 Endeavors.
4 supported Endeavors hasten Currency — a share of its research is already complete.
Bronze Working
Smiths demand ore for the forges. Have 2 improved Iron resources.
Working 2 Iron resources hastens Bronze Working — a share of its research is already complete.
Military Training
A veteran leader teaches what campaigns alone can. Earn a Commendation on an Army Commander.
Your Commander's Commendation hastens Military Training — a share of its research is already complete.
Iron Working
Weapons and soldiers under one roof. Have a Blacksmith and a Barracks on the same tile.
Your arsenal hastens Iron Working — a share of its research is already complete.
Public Life
Every community keeps its own square. Have a Monument in all your settlements.
A Monument in every settlement hastens Public Life — a share of its research is already complete.
Code of Laws
Agreements between peoples need words that bind. Have 2 Friendly relationships.
Friendship with 2 leaders hastens Code of Laws — a share of its research is already complete.
Entertainment
The crowd wants spectacle. Build a Villa or an Arena.
Building for the public good hastens Entertainment — a share of its research is already complete.
Citizenship
A people raise what will outlive them. Build a Wonder.
Your Wonder hastens Citizenship — a share of its research is already complete.
Organized Military
An army answers to one voice. Defeat 4 units of a major civilization while your unit is within your Commander’s command radius.
4 victories under command hasten Organized Military — a share of its research is already complete.
Literacy
The shelves fill with the written word. Slot 5 Codices.
Your 5 slotted Codices hasten Literacy — a share of its research is already complete.
Skilled Trades
A city of workshops turns goods into craft. Assign 9 Resources to one City.
A City working 9 assigned Resources hastens Skilled Trades — a share of its research is already complete.
Philosophy
The examined life needs a contented city. Have an Ecstatic City.
An Ecstatic City hastens Philosophy — a share of its research is already complete.
Commerce
Caravans know every road by name. Have Trade Routes with 3 different civilizations.
Trade with 3 civilizations hastens Commerce — a share of its research is already complete.
The Wheel
The empire finds its rhythm in festivity. Trigger 3 Celebrations.
3 Celebrations hasten The Wheel — a share of its research is already complete.
Navigation
A people that lives by the sea. Have one settlement working 6 Coast tiles, with a Harbor and a Fishing Quay on the same tile.
Your fishing settlement hastens Navigation — a share of its research is already complete.
Engineering
The bath must stand where the water is. Build a Bath with an adjacency bonus of 4 or more.
A well-sited Bath hastens Engineering — a share of its research is already complete.
Mathematics
Scholars bend wholly to study. Have a Specialist on a Library tile in 2 settlements.
Specialists at 2 Libraries hasten Mathematics — a share of its research is already complete.
Mysticism
Wonder stirs the spirit. Discover a Natural Wonder.
Discovering a Natural Wonder hastens Mysticism — a share of its research is already complete.
Discipline
Order is proven against the wild. Defeat an Independent unit.
A victory over the Independents hastens Discipline — a share of its research is already complete.
Tactics
Strike the formation, not the stragglers. Defeat 2 units standing within their own Commander’s command radius.
2 broken formations hasten Tactics — a share of its research is already complete.
